instruction: A miniature Japanese garden landscape: a shallow pond with a defined coping edge, a path of flat stepping stones, clipped rounded earth mounds, and a small stone lantern. Centimeter scale, tidy and balanced.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a miniature Japanese garden. A miniature Japanese garden landscape: a shallow pond with a defined coping edge, a path of flat stepping stones, clipped rounded earth mounds, and a small stone lantern. Centimeter scale, tidy and balanced. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
